newsitem.title: USA: Genuine Parts sets 3-for-2 stock split.
newsitem.headline: Genuine Parts sets 3-for-2 stock split.

text.p: Genuine Parts Co said Tuesday it had declared a three-for-two stock split, payable April 14, record March 14.
After the split, the annual dividend will be $0.96 a share and the new quarterly dividend will be $0.24 a share, it said.
Earlier today the company announced it was raising the quarterly dividend on pre-split shares to $0.36 a share from $0.335.
Genuine Parts is a distributor of automotive replacement parts, industrial replacement parts and office products from operations in the United States, Canada and Mexico.
